correctness.rationale: First unequal retained count in a pair of equal-output deletion patterns forces erasure of at least one current-run letter plus all letters between two equal-symbol runs; hence t>=delta. A pair of patterns deleting one opposite end-run letter and every intervening run collides at delta; same extra deletions extend to all t<length. Smoothing identity Q_(a-1)Q_(b+1)-Q_a Q_b=sum_(j=b+1)^(a-1) z^j is coefficientwise nonnegative, giving balanced upper bound. Cyclic q distinct successive run symbols ensure delta>=q>t, attaining it, and n=r=t+1 proves sharpness as a uniform sufficient q threshold. Independent exact enumeration checked iff onset for 3076 binary and 4923 ternary short-word/deletion cases. Full verifier read; finite checks are corroboration only.
